description: Java class CobaltA11yHelper extending ExploreByTouchHelper to create a virtual D-pad grid for accessibility support in Cobalt, enabling navigation with TalkBack screen reader.

classes.name: CobaltA11yHelper
classes.description: A helper class for accessibility that creates a virtual D-pad grid for navigation when TalkBack is enabled.

methods.name: CobaltA11yHelper
methods.description: Constructor that sets up accessibility delegate for the view.

methods.name: getVirtualViewAt
methods.description: Returns HOST_ID for any x,y coordinate, as touch/mouse support is not implemented.

methods.name: getVisibleVirtualViews
methods.description: Populates the list with 9 virtual view IDs representing a 3x3 grid.

methods.name: focusOnCenter
methods.description: Sets accessibility focus to the center virtual view and delays the actual focus event to avoid Android bug.

methods.name: maybeInjectEvent
methods.description: Injects key events for navigation based on current focus, then refocuses on center.

methods.name: onPopulateNodeForVirtualView
methods.description: Defines bounds and focus behavior for each virtual view in the 3x3 grid.
